summary: On 31 October Russia launched a massive drone attack with 168 strike UAVs including 51 reactive types, targeting energy and railway infrastructure across Ukraine while Ukrainian air defense downed 122 UAVs. Simultaneously a humanitarian operation evacuated civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky in Kherson region under a local ceasefire. The US approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine.
key_points: Russia attacked with 168 strike UAVs (51 reactive), Gerbera and S8000 drones; air defense destroyed 122 UAVs (37 reactive) and two S8000. (Source: @kpszsu/91865)

Strikes hit CHP-6 in Kyiv's Desnyansky district, CHP in Shostka, four substations and a gas distribution facility in Dnipropetrovsk region, and railway infrastructure in Dnipro and Kharkiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023)
Approximately 200,000 families in Dnipro and over 80,000 in Kyiv region lost electricity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023)

Ukrainian air defense engaged Shaheds across multiple regions: Kyiv, Cherkasy, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi, Kirovohrad, Chernihiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/127518, @eRadarrua/127519, @eRadarrua/127521, @eRadarrua/127530)
Geran-5 missiles struck Brovary and CHP-6 in Kyiv; Shaheds entered Moldova and Romania. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77638, @mon1tor_ua/77641, @mon1tor_ua/77667, @mon1tor_ua/77670)

Humanitarian operation in Oleshky, Kherson region, evacuated civilians including a 94-year-old and a one-year-old under a local ceasefire; evacuees crossed into Ukraine via Chernihiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85031)
US State Department approved sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine for $2.1 billion. (Source: @UkraineNow/85014)
DeepState map shows Russian forces advanced near Mykolaivka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23951)

sections.executive_summary: On 31 October Russia launched a massive drone attack with 168 strike UAVs including 51 reactive types, targeting energy and railway infrastructure across Ukraine while Ukrainian air defense downed 122 UAVs. Simultaneously a humanitarian operation evacuated civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky in Kherson region under a local ceasefire. The US approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine.

points: Ukrainian air defense reported destroying 122 strike UAVs (37 reactive) and two S8000 Banderoil/Dan-T drones during the 31 October attack, with approximately 30 UAVs still airborne as of 19:30. (Source: @kpszsu/91865)

The State Department approved a Foreign Military Sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 MSE missiles valued at $2.1 billion, significantly bolstering Ukraine's long-range air defense capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85014)

A humanitarian mission in Oleshky, Kherson region, established a local ceasefire, demined roads, delivered aid, and evacuated civilians — the oldest 94, the youngest just over one year — who crossed into Ukraine via Chernihiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85031)

President Zelensky stated the Oleshky operation demonstrates Russia can de-escalate when forced, and agreed with Erdogan to work on a Black Sea grain corridor; Ukraine proposed trilateral talks in Turkey with European involvement. (Source: @UkraineNow/85037)

Russian forces launched 168 strike UAVs (51 reactive), plus Gerbera and S8000 Banderoil/Dan-T drones, from multiple directions including Sumy, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Zaporizhzhia, and occupied territories, targeting energy and transport infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/91865, @mon1tor_ua/77671)

Geran-5 missiles struck the CHP-6 thermal power plant in Kyiv's Desnyansky district and Brovary; a Geran-5 also hit near Kryvyi Rih heading toward Kropyvnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77638, @mon1tor_ua/77641, @mon1tor_ua/77671)

Shahed UAVs penetrated Moldovan airspace and continued toward Romania, with at least two confirmed entries into Romania, indicating navigation failures or deliberate probing of NATO airspace. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77667, @mon1tor_ua/77670)

Reactive UAVs (likely Gerbera or similar high-speed drones) were employed in at least 51 instances, flying at 120-180 km/h and 200 m altitude, complicating interception. (Source: @eRadarrua/127516, @eRadarrua/127503)
DeepState map update confirms Russian forces advanced near Mykolaivka (likely in Donetsk region), indicating continued ground pressure. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23951)
Russian strikes hit railway infrastructure in Dnipro and Kharkiv, disrupting logistics and civilian transport in key eastern hubs. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023)
Dnipropetrovsk region suffered hits on four substations and a gas distribution facility, exacerbating energy shortages for ~200,000 families. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023)
Reactive UAVs operated in Kryvyi Rih district (Dnipropetrovsk) moving westward, and near Kamianetske, suggesting targeting of industrial and transport nodes. (Source: @kpszsu/91852, @kpszsu/91860)

Sumy region hosted 7 groups of strike UAVs and 1 reactive group; Chernihiv region had 4 strike UAV groups, serving as launch or transit areas for drones heading south. (Source: @eRadarrua/127473, @eRadarrua/127521)
At least 10 Shaheds flew from Sumy region toward Poltava's Lubensky district; 3 Shaheds from Chernihiv region also targeted Lubensky district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77671)

Reactive UAVs were detected on Terne (Sumy) from the north and on Bobrovytsia (Chernihiv) from the northeast, indicating use of high-speed platforms for penetration. (Source: @kpszsu/91861, @kpszsu/91849)
A group of strike UAVs from Sumy region moved toward Lubny (Poltava region), while another group headed toward Lypova Dolyna (Sumy) from the north. (Source: @kpszsu/91877, @kpszsu/91861)

Humanitarian operation in Oleshky (Kherson region) succeeded under a local ceasefire: roads demined, aid delivered, civilians evacuated to Ukrainian-controlled territory via Chernihiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85031)

Reactive UAVs targeted Pivdennoukrainsk in Mykolaiv region from the north, and a guided reactive UAV flew toward Shyroke (Dnipropetrovsk) from Mykolaiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/91831, @eRadarrua/127504)
Zaporizhzhia region launched at least 2 Shaheds toward Dnipropetrovsk's Dnipro district, showing continued use of occupied southern territory as launch points. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77661)
Kirovohrad region saw a strike UAV past Mala Vyska westward and reactive UAVs toward Kompaniivka from the southeast, indicating expanded targeting depth. (Source: @kpszsu/91856)

Massive 31 October attack: 168 strike UAVs (51 reactive), Gerbera, and S8000 Banderoil/Dan-T drones; air defense claimed 122 UAVs destroyed (37 reactive) and 2 S8000, with ~30 UAVs still active at 19:30. (Source: @kpszsu/91865)

Geran-5 missiles struck CHP-6 in Kyiv (Desnyansky district) and Brovary; flight altitude ~200 m, speed 120-180 km/h for reactive UAVs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77641, @mon1tor_ua/77638, @eRadarrua/127516)
Shahed UAVs entered Moldova and Romania airspace; at least two crossed into Romania, raising NATO air policing concerns. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77667, @mon1tor_ua/77670)
US Embassy in Moscow warned of a potential terrorist threat at Tsaritsyno museum-reserve on 31 October, suggesting possible internal Russian instability or false flag. (Source: @UkraineNow/85036)
Ukrainian radar reported 99% of UAVs in airspace were strike piston UAVs or imitators, with reactive UAVs comprising a smaller but high-speed component. (Source: @eRadarrua/127516)

key_developments: Russia launched 168 strike UAVs (51 reactive) plus Gerbera and S8000 drones on 31 Oct 06:30-19:30; air defense downed 122 UAVs and 2 S8000, ~30 UAVs remained airborne. (Source: @kpszsu/91865)

Geran-5 missiles hit CHP-6 in Kyiv's Desnyansky district and Brovary; strikes also hit CHP in Shostka, 4 substations and gas facility in Dnipropetrovsk, railway in Dnipro and Kharkiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023, @mon1tor_ua/77641)
~200,000 families in Dnipro and >80,000 in Kyiv region lost power; emergency repairs underway. (Source: @UkraineNow/85023)
Humanitarian evacuation from Oleshky (Kherson) succeeded under ceasefire: civilians including 94-year-old and infant crossed into Ukraine via Chernihiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/85030, @UkraineNow/85031)
US approved $2.1B sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 MSE missiles to Ukraine, enhancing long-range air defense. (Source: @UkraineNow/85014)
Shahed UAVs violated Moldovan and Romanian airspace; at least two entered Romania, prompting NATO monitoring. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77667, @mon1tor_ua/77670)

sections.threat_assessment: The 31 October drone wave demonstrates Russia's capacity to saturate Ukrainian air defense across multiple regions simultaneously, combining slow piston UAVs as decoys with high-speed reactive platforms and Geran
